jobs.title: Primary Spanish Editor
jobs.reason: This role requires native-level Spanish (editing Spanish-language educational textbooks with mastery of Spanish grammar and ortho-typographic norms), which the candidate does not have — a hard language disqualifier. It also requires three years of textbook editing experience, exceeding the candidate's RA-level background, and sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory-committee members, not a paid staff role — it seeks established experts with regional activist/practitioner experience and reads as an unpaid/speculative advisory position rather than a genuine entry-level paid vacancy. The human-rights/securitisation topic is interesting, but the committee is aimed at senior experts, not an early-career candidate.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Applications
jobs.reason: A "Manager"-level role requiring 3–6 years of demonstrable technical project-management experience and Scrum Master / ServiceNow / enterprise-integration expertise the candidate does not have — both a level and a deep-technical disqualifier. Although a London option exists, the essential experience and technical requirements are far beyond an early-career research profile.

jobs.title: Research Analyst - Research and Innovation Ecosystems
jobs.reason: On-level for a postgraduate with strong research and writing, which the candidate has, though the posting leans on "work experience beyond university" and a "proven track record delivering projects" that the candidate meets only partly through RA work. The topic — research and innovation policy, metascience and higher-education systems — aligns closely with the candidate's HRK/higher-education background, but it sits outside the core international-law and security interest zones, holding interest moderate. English fluency is essential and other languages only an asset, so no language gate applies.

jobs.title: Journals and Digital Content Coordinator
jobs.reason: An entry-level coordinator role at a leading global affairs think tank; the candidate's academic publishing experience and research background transfer, though this is more a publications/digital-content administration post than a research role, and dedicated digital-content and publishing-workflow experience is a partial gap. ODI is a respected policy institution, giving it adjacent interest, but the coordinator function sits outside the candidate's core research and analysis mission, which holds the score in the "worth a look" band.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Officer - Sahel
jobs.reason: Excluded by the London-only location filter — the role is based in Niamey, Niger with no London or remote option. It is also a "Senior" finance role requiring finance experience the candidate lacks, so it fails on multiple counts.

jobs.title: Associate Publisher – SN Journals
jobs.reason: Requires 5–7 years of direct journal-management experience as an essential, which the candidate plainly lacks — a hard level/experience disqualifier. It is also a commercial publishing-operations role outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Analyst and Programme Administrator for the Defence and Military Analysis Programme
jobs.reason: The hybrid research-plus-administration profile is a strong on-level fit — the candidate's RA work, policy writing and funding-programme administration at the German Rectors' Conference map directly onto both halves of the role. IISS is a core zone (b)/(c) target and the defence/security focus aligns well with the candidate's published work on German defence policy; the security-studies angle keeps interest high.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter - World Wide Inspections
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — it requires an essential 5–8 years of experience in talent acquisition / procurement / vendor management, and a bachelor's degree in engineering, neither of which the candidate has. It is also a recruitment/procurement function entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and geopolitical interests.

jobs.title: PhD Programme Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an entry-to-junior professional-services administrative role, degree-level with transferable skills the candidate has (higher-education administration, funding allocation at the German Rectors' Conference, stakeholder liaison, IT/Office). However, it is a student-facing programme-administration post rather than research, so paper fit is only moderate and the "servicing committee meetings" experience is a partial gap. Higher-education administration sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, which holds the score down.
jobs.salary: £36,513 to £41,565 pa (potential to progress to £44,468), inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical, senior full-stack software-engineering role whose essential requirements — production-grade Java (Spring Boot), front-end frameworks, AWS/Kubernetes, CI/CD, secure coding — are far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and web-scripting familiarity. It is also explicitly senior and internal-applicants-only, so it fails on level and access as well.
jobs.salary: £53,949–£62,160 pa (potential to £69,073) inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Manager - Print
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — it is a Senior Manager role requiring extensive print/paper procurement, category-management and supplier-management experience the candidate lacks. It is also entirely outside the candidate's research/policy interests and skill set.
